text:
mara: Heads up — noticed duplicate charge records when the Node SDK retried 429s in the payments sample. Two identical POSTs in one user flow. Anyone else hit this?
ryan: Oof. Is payments.create marked idempotent in the sample app? SDK only does safe retries for idempotent ops by default.
mara: It isn't. Sample calls `client.payments.create()` with no idempotency header. Server logs show two separate POSTs accepted.
cheng: Are these retries from the SDK retry layer or infra-level retries after a timeout?
sam-qe: QE trace shows SDK emitted a retry due to a 429: 
```
2026-03-18T14:03:21Z WARN request retrying status=429 attempt=1
2026-03-18T14:03:22Z INFO outgoing request id=req-01 method=POST /v1/payments
2026-03-18T14:03:23Z INFO outgoing request id=req-02 method=POST /v1/payments
```
So SDK replayed the POST.
anya: Reminder: currently our SDKs treat 429 as retryable for non-streaming calls. That leads to unsafe replays for non-idempotent endpoints. We need consistent behavior across Node/Python/Rust.
ryan: Proposal: change default so SDKs DO NOT auto-retry 429s for non-idempotent methods. Provide an `idempotencyKey` option (or `Idempotency-Key` header) to opt into safe replays.
cheng: We could also add an optional response hint header `X-Can-Retry: true|false` so SDKs can learn server intent. Helpful for rollout but not required.
mara: Agreed on SDK-first change. New policy: only retry 429 if (a) caller provided idempotency key, or (b) method is marked idempotent in the SDK metadata. Use exponential backoff with full jitter, cap retries. For non-idempotent methods return the 429 to the app with guidance in the error `UNSAFE_REPLAY`.
anya: Streaming endpoints are inherently non-idempotent — never auto-retry 429s for streaming APIs.
sam-qe: Edge case: credential refresh can trigger a replay. If a token refresh happens mid-flight, we should avoid replaying non-idempotent calls. Flag in-flight requests `canReplay=false` when auth refresh occurs.
ryan: Implementation checklist: 
- SDK API: add `idempotencyKey` param + automatically set `Idempotency-Key` header when present.
- SDK behavior: only retry 429s when `Idempotency-Key` present or method metadata = `idempotent:true`.
- Backoff defaults: base=100ms, cap=3000ms, attempts<=5, strategy=full_jitter.
- Samples: update payments sample to include idempotency key and doc snippet.
- Docs: add migration note and `UNSAFE_REPLAY` error guidance.
- Tests: add e2e where server returns 429 then 200 on replay to verify safe replay path.
cheng: Quick Node backoff helper example:
```
function jitterDelay(attempt) {
  const base = 100;
  const cap = 3000;
  const max = Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  return Math.random() * max; // full jitter
}
```
anya: For parity, publish a small YAML spec listing `idempotent_methods` and `retry_policy` that all SDKs implement.
mara: UX: surface `UNSAFE_REPLAY` error code when SDK refuses to retry because idempotency is missing. That helps integrators debug quickly.
ci-bot: CI for branch `devex/replay-guard` ran: 48 passed, 1 flaky timeout.
ryan: Owners — @anya implement SDK surface changes (Node+Python), @cheng add metadata & shared spec, @mara update sample app & docs, @sam-qe add e2e flakiness tests. I'll open GH issues and link them here.
mara: Cool — adding to sprint and will add a short migration note so external sample users aren't surprised. :thumbsup:
